source: External transfer-matrix and RCWA reference for the SHAARP.py isotropic multilayer Fresnel benchmark. Legs: tmm (Byrnes, transfer-matrix), inkstone (Song/Catrysse/Fan, RCWA truncated to the zeroth order), and an Abeles characteristic-matrix closed form.
convention: n = n' + i k with exp(-i omega t); loss is a positive imaginary part.
units: thicknesses and wavelengths in micrometres; angles in degrees
quantities: R and T are POWER ratios. T carries the obliquity factor Re(n_exit cos theta_exit)/Re(n_inc cos theta_inc), so a lossless stack satisfies R+T=1.

cases.description: Bare air/glass interface (n=1.5), angle sweep. Brewster zero in p.
cases.notes: Interior layer index equals the substrate index, so this is physically a bare interface; the layer exists only because inkstone cannot build a zero-layer stack.

cases.description: air / n=2.35 x 0.5 um / n=1.52 at 633 nm, angle sweep.
Same film at normal incidence, 400-800 nm. Fabry-Perot fringes.
cases.notes: The interference leg proper: several full fringes across the sweep.

cases.description: 4x (n=2.35 / n=1.46) quarter-wave pairs on glass, 400-800 nm, normal incidence.
cases.notes: Eight interior layers with a high-reflectance stopband centred on 633 nm. Layer chaining is exercised where a single-interface error cannot hide.

cases.description: air / 13.9 nm Au / quartz at 800 nm, angle sweep. Complex index; R+T < 1.
cases.notes: Mirrors the SHAARP.ml paper Fig. 4(d) Au-on-quartz geometry.

metadata.au_index_source: Johnson & Christy (1972) Phys. Rev. B 6, 4370, at 800 nm

cases.description: Absentee film: optical thickness lam/2 at 633 nm, normal incidence only.
cases.notes: Discriminating anchor: a half-wave layer is optically absent at normal incidence, so R must equal the BARE air/glass value ((1-1.52)/(1+1.52))^2, independent of the film index. A solver that merely looks plausible will not reproduce this.
